    • lockById

      Optional<Identity> lockById(UUID id)
      Finds an identity and locks its row until the surrounding transaction ends, so that concurrent callers serialize on it. Call it inside a transaction.
      Parameters:
      id - the identity UUID
      Returns:
      the identity, or empty if not found

    • findPage

      List<Identity> findPage(Optional<IdentityStatus> status, Optional<UUID> roleId, Optional<Set<UUID>> ids, int page, int size)
      Returns one page of identities, oldest first: ordered by creation time, then by id. Every filter given must match.
      Parameters:
      status - only identities with this status; empty for any status
      roleId - only identities assigned this who-rbac role, matched in the query against who-rbac's role assignments, so a role's holders are never listed first; empty for any role. Give one only where who-rbac's schema is installed
      ids - only identities among these ids; empty for any id. An empty set matches none
      page - the zero-based page number; must not be negative
      size - the most identities on a page; must be positive
      Returns:
      the identities on that page (never null; empty past the last page)

    • count

      long count(Optional<IdentityStatus> status, Optional<UUID> roleId, Optional<Set<UUID>> ids)
      Counts the identities findPage(Optional, Optional, Optional, int, int) pages through for the same filters.
      Parameters:
      status - only identities with this status; empty for any status
      roleId - only identities assigned this who-rbac role; empty for any role
      ids - only identities among these ids; empty for any id. An empty set matches none
      Returns:
      how many identities match

    • changeStatus

      default boolean changeStatus(UUID id, IdentityStatus status)
      Sets the status of the identity with the given UUID, reporting whether anything changed. The default finds then saves; implementations backed by a database should override it with one conditional update, so that concurrent callers cannot both see a change.
      Parameters:
      id - the identity UUID
      status - the new status
      Returns:
      true only if the identity exists and its status was different
